mapper.insert: insert into image ( file_div, media_id, store_locate, store_fname, store_tname, org_fname ) values ( #{mediaType}, #{mediaId}, #{fullPath}, #{fname}, #{tname}, #{orgFile} )
mapper.select: select file_id, store_locate, store_tname, org_fname from image where 1=1 and media_id = #{id} and file_div = #{file_div}
select concat(store_locate,'/',store_fname) as full_file_path , concat(store_locate,'/',store_tname) as full_thumb_path from image where file_id = #{fileId}
